definitions.explanation: An uncultivated, desolate area with little vegetation.

examples.japanese: {広大|こうだい}な{荒野|こうや}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
{荒野|こうや}を{一人|ひとり}で{旅|たび}する。
examples.english: To travel alone through the wilderness.

examples.japanese: {荒野|こうや}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}いた。

notes:
{荒野|こうや} describes desolate, uncultivated wilderness or wasteland.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
{荒|あら/こう} (wild, rough) + {野|の/や} (field, plain)

ALTERNATE READINGS:
- こうや (most common)
- あらの (literary)
- あれの (archaic)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広大|こうだい}な{荒野|こうや}: vast wilderness
- {荒野|こうや}を{旅|たび}する: to travel through the wilderness
- {荒野|こうや}に{花|はな}が{咲|さ}く: flowers bloom in the wasteland

METAPHORICAL USE:
Used figuratively to describe emotional desolation or a difficult, lonely situation.

RELATED TERMS:
- {砂漠|さばく}: desert
- {原野|げんや}: wilderness, plains
- {荒地|あれち}: wasteland
